feedback.worked_solution:
We want to express the area $A$ between the function $f(x)=\sqrt{x+4}+1$ and the $x$-axis, between $x=-3$ and $x=2.$

This can be expressed as the definite integral of $f(x)=\sqrt{x+4}+1$ between the lower limit $x=-3$ and the upper limit $x=2,$ as follows:

$$
A={\int }_{-3}^{2}\sqrt{x+4}+1\,\text{d}x
$$
